# `expect.add`: Add expectation

Adds a test for the model (size, symmetry, attachment, no intersections, budget, watertight) that runs after every change.

- Category: expect
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(1) to add; the check it runs once is that check's cost
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: test, assert, constraint check, requirement

Expectations are tests for models: every response that changes the scene ends with a test line such as `tests 3/4 pass; failing: E2 attached(lid, crate)`. Write them first and model until they pass.

- `dims`: size of an object with its children, each of width (X), height (Y), depth (Z) as `{min, max}`.
- `symmetric`: `a` and `b` mirror each other across `axis = at` (default the left-right plane x = 0); without `b`, `a` mirrors itself across its center.
- `attached`: gap at most `max_gap` (1 mm) and, if given, sinking in at most `max_penetration`.
- `not_intersecting`: none of the listed objects pass through or sit inside each other.
- `budget`: triangle count, by default at most the asset class budget.
- `watertight`: closed meshes facing outward (needed for 3D printing, bakes and volume).

Objects are remembered by id, so renaming them keeps the test.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expect` | `ExpectArgs` | required | The test: one of dims, symmetric, attached, not_intersecting, budget, watertight. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Name; `E1`, `E2`, ... when omitted. |

## Examples

```json
{"expect":{"attached":{"part":"lid","to":"crate"}}}
```

Result: `added E1 attached(lid, crate): passes now (gap 0 mm)`
